First run of the tests for ticket #28, before the feature exists, on Pixel_10
(emulator-5554), with no code for the ticket written yet.

Base: commit 762ab4a, branch ticket-28-fetch-results, tests not yet
committed. Five runs, one after the other on 11 November 2026, each shown in
full below: the new tests of ticket #28, then only the tests of tickets #24,
#18, #10 and #22 that this ticket changed, picked by name (see
docs/tests/28.md, "Changes to the tests of tickets #10, #18, #22 and #24").

Results:

- Ticket #28 (results_driver.dart): all 11 fail because the feature is
  missing.
  - 9 fail because the screen shows only the three lines, "Số vé: …",
    "Tỉnh: …" and "Ngày: …", with no answer below them: the two-prize win
    (921443), the Đặc biệt win, the Giải Tám win, the loss, "Chưa có kết
    quả", "Vé quá cũ, không dò được", and "Không tải được kết quả, thử lại
    sau" with no internet and with a page that isn't the feed. The Cà Mau
    test is among them: 4d didn't show, the three lines did.
  - 2 fail because the app never asked for the feed: "the site doesn't
    answer within 10 seconds" and "Đang đọc vé... stays until the answer
    shows" ("the app did not fetch https://xskt.com.vn/rss-feed/mien-nam-
    xsmn.rss through Dart's HttpClient. It asked for: []").
  - In the "no internet" test, airplane mode went on, Android reported no
    network, and airplane mode was off again after the run.
- Ticket #24 (ticket_fields_driver.dart, 1 test): fails because the answer
  line is missing below the three lines.
- Ticket #18 (ticket_text_driver.dart, 6 tests): 5 fail because the answer
  line is missing below the three lines. 1 passes: "Given a photo taken in
  the app, when real ML Kit reads it, ...". It accepts 4d, and the emulator's
  room didn't read as a ticket, so it showed 4d, as it does before and after
  this ticket. It can only fail on the answer when the room reads as a ticket.
- Ticket #10 (photo_screen_driver.dart, 12 tests): all 12 fail at "the photo
  screen is open", which now waits for the answer below the three lines.
- Ticket #22 (photo_crop_driver.dart on photo_crop_app.dart, 6 tests): all 6
  fail because the answer line is missing, either in the test itself or in
  its earlier photo ("givenPhotoKeptEarlier").

Before this run, the 11 new tests were run once on an earlier layout, with
the results site in its own test app instead of in ticket_text_app.dart.
They failed the same way, test for test. That earlier output isn't kept here.
